BiblicalUsage: Jetur is a son of Ishmael. In Genesis 25:15, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. The fuller story is told on the Jetur profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jetur matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
